clan.name: Clan
clan.description: Determines whether the Traveller comes from a Minor or Major (Tlaukhu) clan.

ancestral_deeds.name: Ancestral Deeds
ancestral_deeds.description: What Territory your clan ancestor acquired. DM+1 if Major Clan.

1.label: Your ancestor shamed the clan and you come from a branch long dishonoured.

2.label: Your family's glory days are long gone, all that is left is the tales of great landholdings now lost to upstarts.

3.label: Your family made its fortune in the great expansion after the discovery of jump drive; most family holdings are on distant worlds.

4.label: Your family are the descendants of an ancient hero forgotten by most Aslan.

5.label: Your family's ancestor was a trickster who deceived his enemies.

6.label: Your ancestors were conquerors and great warriors.

7.label: Your family is one of the most influential and wealthy in the Hierate.

past_deeds.name: Past Deeds
past_deeds.description: Roll twice — once for your grandfather's deeds, once for your father's deeds. Each modifies Ancestral Territory.

2.label: Dishonoured! Your forebear committed some dishonourable act that caused the clan to strip your family of all territory.

3.label: Your forebear was beset by many foes, one of whom conquered much of your land.

4.label: Your forebear was a fool who gambled away much of your land.

5.label: Your forebear suffered from a degenerative genetic disease that you may have inherited.

6.label: Your forebear barely managed to hold onto your landhold.

7.label: Your forebear held the family ground.

8.label: Your forebear added to the family holdings.

9.label: Your forebear was a notable warrior and leader.

10.label: Your forebear was a great conqueror.

11.label: Your forebear was one of the great heroes of the Hierate.

12.label: Your forebear was legendary throughout the Hierate.

family_inheritance.name: Family Inheritance
family_inheritance.description: Determines your birth order. Only the first son/eldest daughter inherits full Ancestral Territory.

rite_of_passage_events.name: Rite of Passage Events
rite_of_passage_events.description: Triggered when doubles are rolled during the Rite of Passage.

1+1.label: You are believed to have a great destiny, and the clan looks for great things from you. You must excel or disappoint your ancestors.

2+2.label: Impressive Performance. You are given Cr5000 as a reward for your exemplary performance in the rite.

3+3.label: You befriend one of the other young Aslan undergoing the rite that day.

4+4.label: One of the other Aslan undergoing the rite tries to outdo you.

5+5.label: You are wounded in one of the tests, leaving a distinctive scar across your fur.

6+6.label: I Will Not Fail! Your rite tests you to the limit, but you are determined not to give in.
